LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_1: Why Do Free Servers Experience Disruptions?
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_2: Connection stability is a major challenge that both users and VPN service providers struggle with. Contrary to what some users believe, this difference in performance is not a marketing strategy to push people toward premium plans, it is a technical battle between filtering systems and VPN applications.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_3: Automatic IP Detection Due to High User Density
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_4: Although VpnHood is equipped with DPI Proof (Deep Packet Inspection), free servers, due to their public nature, host thousands of simultaneous connection requests. This volume of traffic is quickly detected by filtering systems, leading to IP blocks. Meanwhile, premium servers, due to lower traffic loads and a larger number of available servers, leave a much smaller footprint and therefore remain hidden from filtering systems.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_6: Differences in the policies of Internet Service Providers (ISPs) cause users to have varying experiences. It is very common for one user in a specific region to connect successfully with one operator, while another user in the same region but with a different operator cannot connect. This is due to different layers of filtering applied directly at the ISP level.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_8: Inability to connect to free servers is not a permanent condition. Filtering systems operate dynamically and in real time. If a server is unavailable today, it means its IP has been added to a local or global blacklist. Technical teams continuously replace these IPs as much as possible. For this reason, a server that is inaccessible today may become available again tomorrow after an IP update or changes in filtering systems. This is an ongoing process at the network infrastructure layer and is completely outside the control of VPN applications.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_11: Always use the latest version of the app to receive the newest server list.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_13: Switching between Wi‑Fi and mobile data can bypass local ISP restrictions.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_15: By selecting the Auto option in the location list, the app will find an accessible location and connect you to the most suitable server.
LEARN_MORE_FREE_SERVERS_DISRUPTIONS_17: Using the Try Premium option ensures that your ability to connect to any VPN server is not fully blocked. You can temporarily use premium servers and upgrade if needed.
